g.text: MathGen - Epoch Loop (the big picture over 10 epochs)
We repeat the whole thing 10 times.
sees the entire training set once.
Train on every batch, learning a little each step.
[over batches (the inner loop from Diagram A)]
End of epoch: check progress on UNSEEN data
run model on the validation set
val_loss (how wrong on data it never trained on)
save best.pt (this is our best model so far)
After training, eval_model.py loads best.pt and checks the model
Low loss alone does NOT prove the model is good -
a real test is whether its output is usable.
